subject: Ashridge next-week demo — travel hiccup and cover options
messages:

Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@ashridgepharm.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Travel delay — Demo on Thu 5/13

Hi Hannah,

Quick heads-up: I'm on a regional rail run this morning and my connection out of Portland got cancelled. The team is still planning the Ashridge site visits the week of 5/11, but our travel window may compress. Two asks: 1) can we shorten Thursday's demo (5/13 10:00 PT) to a 30-minute highlights session if our morning meetings run long, or 2) can we take a recording + 30-minute live Q&A that afternoon?

I attached our updated itinerary (light edits to arrival times) so you can see the overlap. If neither works, can we move to Friday morning? Sorry for the churn — this trip is just chaotic.

Thanks,

Ashridge Pharmaceuticals

Hi Sophie — thanks for the update and for sending the itinerary. Totally understand. Two quick options that keep things productive:

• Option A — compress to 30 minutes (10:00–10:30 PT): we’ll prioritize the high-impact flows (integration + cost/perf numbers) and leave open follow-up Q&A with your engineers.
• Option B — pre-record the walkthrough (we can send the recording by noon) + a live 30-minute Q&A at 3:00 PT. Recording will cover the full demo deck; Q&A will be focused.

If Friday morning is easier for you, we can also move the live session to 5/14 09:00 PT. Grace — can you cover the compressed 30‑minute run if Hannah is on another call? Marcus, flag if we need a deeper infra dive — I'll loop you only if they pick the full live.

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference

(Referenced attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf)
